term: only first movers are purely determined
definition: Every being whose real determinations are all pure perfections is a first mover moved by none.
note: Analyst background condition, not a premise of any argument. Under it and the two pure-act premises, DEF-PURELY-DETERMINED-INDISCERNIBLES-IDENTICAL says no more than at-most-one first mover. It holds, for example, if every non-first being has some limited or received determination; that is not established here.
